attribution.both: neither component meets its dominance rule
attribution.component_split: RMS magnitude divided by fixed-boundary plus vacuum-difference RMS magnitudes; the two reported shares sum to one
attribution.flux_function_dominated: fixed-boundary share is at least two thirds
attribution.vacuum_field_dominated: vacuum-difference share is at least two thirds and the gauged border discrepancy exceeds the nearby-root scale

evaluation_point: the labelled psi map; no root search or iteration
external_field: nineteen released conductors and released currents

fixed_boundary_control.source: Delta-star applied directly to the same label

gauge: one additive constant from the landed plasma-subtraction measure
measurement: free-boundary residual evaluated at labelled DIII-D maps

nearby_root_criterion.basis: the 0.05-class measured strict-GS representability scale; a map farther away than that is not treated as evidence for a nearby root
nearby_root_criterion.normalisation: whole-grid RMS divided by total labelled psi range

profiles: p-prime and FF-prime from extract_flux_functions on the label

regions.boundary_band: one-cell dilation minus one-cell erosion of label core
regions.measure: fraction of squared residual; three fractions sum to one
regions.plasma_interior: label core eroded by one grid cell

selection.rule: first five lexicographic shots with a finite diverted frame; the eligible time nearest each shot's median eligible time
